mapper.select: SELECT port.TT AS tt , port.INST_DAYS AS inst_days , TO_CHAR(port.MANGI, 'yyyy"년" mm"월" dd"일만기"') AS mangi , port.DT AS dt , port.YEAR_BETA AS year_beta , port.MON_BETA AS mon_beta , t1.PORT_NUM AS port_num , t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , NVL(ya.SRS_CD, ya.BLBG_TCKR) AS srs_cd , ya.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , ya.JM_NM AS jm_nm , t1.JONGA AS jonga , CASE WHEN tt.hangsa_ga IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (t1.JONGA / NULLIF(tt.hangsa_ga, 0) - 1) * 100 END AS clearance , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.PRICE_PER, 0) = 0 THEN port.PRICE_PER ELSE t1.PRICE_PER END AS price_per , CASE WHEN tt.hangsa_ga IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (t1.JONGA / NULLIF(tt.hangsa_ga, 0) - 1) >= CASE WHEN NVL(t1.PRICE_PER, 0) = 0 THEN port.PRICE_PER / 100 ELSE t1.PRICE_PER / 100 END THEN 'LOW' WHEN (t1.JONGA / NULLIF(tt.hangsa_ga, 0) - 1) <= CASE WHEN NVL(t1.PRICE_PER, 0) = 0 THEN port.PRICE_PER / 100 ELSE t1.PRICE_PER / 100 END * -1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'UNDECIDED' END AS price_status , ya.CURRENCY AS currency , tt.jm_cd AS opt_jm_cd , tt.jm_nm AS opt_jm_nm , tt.qty AS qty , tt.hangsa_ga AS hangsa_ga , tt.risk_value AS risk_value FROM USPM_PORT port , USPM t1 , SYM0YA ya , ( SELECT yz.TRUSTEE , ya.CHANGE_JM_CD , ya.JM_CD , ya.JM_NM , ya.HANGSA_GA , SUM(NVL(yz.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(yz.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.RIGHT_JUSU, 0)) AS qty , SUM(NVL(yz.DELTA_RISK_VALUE, 0) + NVL(yz.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE, 0) + NVL(yz.VEGA_RISK_VALUE, 0)) AS risk_value FROM SYM0YZ yz , SYM0YA ya WHERE yz.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND yz.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND yz.YMD = #{ymd} AND ya.HANGSA_GA IS NOT NULL AND ya.CORP_GR = yz.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = yz.JM_CD GROUP BY yz.TRUSTEE, ya.CHANGE_JM_CD, ya.JM_CD, ya.JM_NM, ya.HANGSA_GA HAVING SUM(NVL(yz.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(yz.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.RIGHT_JUSU, 0)) > 0 ) tt WHERE port.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND port.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND port.TYMD = #{ymd} AND t1.CORP_GR = port.CORP_GR AND t1.FUND_CD = port.FUND_CD AND t1.YMD = port.TYMD AND t1.PORT_NUM = port.PORT_NUM AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND tt.TRUSTEE(+) = '(' || port.PORT_NUM || ')' AND tt.CHANGE_JM_CD(+) = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY t1.PORT_NUM, t1.JM_CD, tt.HANGSA_GA
